title: Quarterly initiative playbook: Private/VPC on-prem upgrade & rollout synchronization
creator: Priya Nair
description: Objective: produce a repeatable quarterly planning and execution playbook that synchronizes roadmap milestones, cross-cluster upgrade windows, and OKR tracking for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features. Scope includes upgrade orchestration (rolling upgrades across customer clusters), compatibility gating for private control plane components, enterprise rollout communications, and measurable OKR mapping for Q2 releases. This ticket captures the playbook, acceptance criteria, release cadence, key stakeholders, and initial runbook templates to be handed to Program Management and Engineering leads.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document reviewed and approved by Eng Tech Lead and Security (SSO/KMS)
3 rollout templates created: staggered-rolling, blue-green for single-tenant, and batched-window for multi-tenant
OKRs mapped to milestones with owner and measurement dashboard for each key result
Dependencies and gating policy defined (backout, canary thresholds, SLA windows)
Security review completed and signed off before canary customers chosen
success_metrics: <10% increase in incident page-ons during upgrade windows compared to baseline
95% of scheduled upgrades complete within the planned maintenance window
OKR: reduce mean upgrade time by 20% quarter-over-quarter
Customer satisfaction (post-upgrade survey) >= 4.0/5 for pilot customers
milestones: Feb 10: Draft playbook and runbook templates (done)
Feb 18: Internal review with Eng reliability and Security (feedback captured)
Mar 01: Pilot upgrade plan for two on-prem customers & two VPC customers
Mar 15: Canary rollout and metric dashboard live
Mar 25: Post-pilot retrospective and final playbook edits
Mar 31: Playbook published and handed off to Program/Support
risks: Complex dependency matrix across control plane and private runtime may cause unexpected incompatibilities
Insufficient telemetry for small on-prem deployments could hide regressions
Customer maintenance windows vary by region and legal constraints
Security approval delays could postpone canary start
